description: SISTERS, OR- Today, Deschutes County Commissioner and Republican nominee for Oregon’s 5th Congressional District, Patti Adair, announced her support of the lawsuits filed by Marion County and the city of Salem against the U.S. Army Corps of Engineers over the agency’s planned drawdown of Detroit Reservoir.
